ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Which of the following are the predators of mayflies?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with “Leaves & Algae” on the left, “Mayflies” in the upper middle, “Trout” on the right, and “Humans” further to the right. In the figure, there is an arrow from the “Mayflies” box pointing to the “Trout” box on the right. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate from the food or prey being eaten to the predator. Because the arrow points from “Mayflies” to “Trout,” the animal that preys on mayflies is trout.
